slices.focus: Ariana builds a neighborhood-level tracking board that makes the archive visible as a program
slices.summary: Ariana creates a tracking board organized by named neighborhoods with monthly counts for recorded interviews, complete metadata, signed permissions, and backup compliance. The board shifts her supervisor's view from salvage operation to structured program.
open_loops: Creating a one-page monthly summary with a 'next bottleneck' section
Keeping the board lean to avoid it becoming a second job
Using the gap between interviews recorded and fully cleared as the key metric
decisions: Ariana shifted the oral-history archive from recovery mode into a measurable program with monthly tracking of interview
